sentences.text: 2. Although the issue of contributory negligence is raised on the part of the driver/injured, learned counsels for the parties are agreeable that the matter can be settled through negotiations in the ensuing Pre- Lok Adalat.

3. Accordingly, both the parties are directed to appear for Pre-Lok Adalat negotiations before the learned Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee, for exploring the possibility of an amicable settlement, on 07.02.2024 at 3:00 PM.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Awaiting the outcome of the Pre-Lok Adalat Mediation, re- notify before this Court on 22.05.2024.
